tool_args.rationale: The observations show near-linear scaling with u_now and little apparent dependence on x_now, matching the authorized uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep form. H variation supplies information on its two parameters; the other authorized mechanisms are inconsistent with the observed feature dependence. Fit E_kv and eta_kv numerically to the supplied rows and predict with the specified law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary u_now, x_now, and H; their near-proportional response to u_now is consistent with the two-parameter Kelvin–Voigt law, so another paid batch is not presently needed.
Its response should depend on x_now as well as u_now, but large changes in x_now do not produce the corresponding changes in y.
The observed response is nearly proportional to u_now across the sampled range, rather than showing the strong nonlinear dependence expected from this candidate.
